title: Mimamsa Cycle 5 source-library registers (CSV column contracts)
note: CSV registers; each entry fixes column order (enforced by tools/check_c5.py) and controlled values. Identifiers from earlier registers (instr_id, chain_id, change_id, conflict_id, acq_id, record and case ids) are referenced, never overwritten. Enumerated columns are checked on their first token; a parenthesised qualifier may follow (e.g. 'PARTIAL (AMENDMENT_CHAIN_INCOMPLETE)', the brief's label, kept compatible with policy v1).

source_master_register.csv.reuse: Brief fields A (source_id..completeness_status) plus SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY v1 fields (document_authority, carrier_provenance) from docs/legal-audit/schemas/source.schema.json; authentication_status carries CALIBRATION-02 source_authentication_register state when a row exists.

acquisition_register.csv.reuse: D3 ranked acquisition list; existing ACQ ids referenced, never renumbered.

amendment_register.csv.reuse: Brief fields C; carries ARMY-RULES-CHAIN-01 instrument register and WS-A army_act_amendment_chain columns verbatim (publication_date / commencement_as_printed / effective_date_status kept distinct).

provision_amendment_chain.csv.reuse: Brief chain Publication->Provision->Instrument->Before->After->Effective->Period->Evidence; derived from WS-A provision_change_log (+ supersessions) and ARMY-RULES-CHAIN-01 provision chronology.

provision_register.csv.reuse: Brief fields B; locator form follows CALIBRATION-02 rule_index_spec/provision_record.schema.json (doc_id#rNN); provision ids reuse WS-D doc ids (rules-army-rules-1954).

source_conflict_register.csv.reuse: Brief fields D; union of SOURCE-CONFLICTS-01, CALIBRATION-02 source_conflicts_c4, WS-B open inconsistencies, ARMY-RULES-CHAIN-01 official-note discrepancies, plus C5 documentary conflicts.

corpus_crosswalk.csv.reuse: Brief fields E; items parsed from WS-D canonical_coverage.csv; case rows from cases_53.jsonl ids.
